scope: Targeted property tests verifying Topological Simplex Normal Form (TSNF), integer Smith Normal Form reduction, and Euler-Poincare invariance across random finite simplicial complexes (3-8 vertices)

properties_verified.details: Verified exact equality chi_cells == chi_homology (len(V) - len(E) + len(F) == b0 - b1 + b2) across 100 random simplicial complexes with 3 to 8 vertices, arbitrary face counts, and valid face orientations.
Verified 0-th Betti number b0 strictly equals the count of connected components derived from an independent BFS graph traversal oracle.
Verified S^2 (chi=2, b0=1, b1=0, b2=1), D^2 (chi=1, b0=1, b1=0, b2=0), and RP^2 (chi=1, b0=1, b1=0, b2=0 with Z_2 torsion coefficient 2) via exact integer Smith Normal Form reduction.
Verified that non-canonical vertex orderings, duplicate simplex declarations, and simplicial closure boundary omissions fail closed with Reject and descriptive defect diagnostics.
